desc:
A PrestaShop store redesign gives your shop a fresher, clearer look without changing your products or page addresses. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds the home, category and product pages on a copy, shows you a preview, then switches it on.

## What is a PrestaShop redesign?

A PrestaShop redesign changes how your store looks and works while keeping what sits underneath. The layout, colors, fonts, buttons, header, footer and page templates are rebuilt. Your catalog, customer accounts, orders and page addresses stay as they are.

This differs from a migration, where data moves to a new platform, and from buying a new theme, where you install a template and fill it in. A redesign starts from your shop and your brand.

## Why an old design costs you customers

Shoppers judge a store quickly, and they judge it by how it looks and feels. An outdated layout, cramped product pages or a menu that is hard to use on a phone suggests a shop that is not looked after. Visitors who doubt a shop hesitate to pay on it.

Age also shows in speed and structure. Old themes often load heavy images, depend on outdated scripts or break on newer phones. A tidy redesign addresses these along with the appearance.

## How redesign work improves results

Redesign improves results when it makes the buying path clearer. A strong home page leads visitors into the right categories. Clean category listings let people compare items quickly. A better product page puts the image, price, options and button where thumbs and eyes expect them. Properly sized images shorten load times, which helps shoppers stay.

Keeping product and page addresses unchanged protects the search visibility your pages have earned. We cannot promise ranking or sales changes, because both depend on your market and competition. We can promise careful handling of the parts that cause avoidable damage.

## What a good PrestaShop redesign includes

- A design direction agreed before building starts, with your brand in mind.
- A refreshed color palette, font choices and button styles used consistently.
- A rebuilt header and footer with clear menus and contact details.
- A home page that leads visitors to your main categories and best sellers.
- Category listings that show products, filters and sorting without clutter.
- Product pages with a clear image area, price, options and add to cart button.
- Custom home blocks for banners, featured products or brand messages.
- Image sizes set so pages load faster on phones.
- Restyled cart, checkout, account and order pages in larger packages.
- A check of page titles and links after launch.

## How we run the project

First we review your shop and talk through your brand, your customers and what you dislike about the current look. We agree a design direction, then rebuild the pages on a duplicate of your store so your live shop keeps taking orders.

You review a preview link and ask for changes. When you approve, we switch the new design on and check titles and links. The Basic package refreshes the home page and brand style across the shop. Standard redesigns home, category and product pages together with a few custom home blocks. Premium extends the work to cart, checkout and account pages, adds more custom blocks and finishes with a link and title check after launch.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Collect examples of stores whose look you like and note why.
- Supply your logo, brand colors and best product photos.
- Review the preview on your own phone, not only on a computer.
- Keep your page addresses and product names unchanged.
- Tell us which modules are essential to the shop.

**Avoid:**
- Redesigning the same weekend as a major sale.
- Adding many animations that slow pages down.
- Using low quality photos in a polished layout.
- Renaming page URLs simply because the layout was redesigned.
- Approving the preview without testing a real checkout.

## Who this is for

This service suits established shops whose look has aged while their catalog keeps growing. It suits owners who rebranded and need the store to match. It also suits sellers whose mobile pages feel cramped and who want the same products presented more clearly.

## How to get started

Send us your shop address, your brand assets and a few reference sites you like. Give us staff or developer access so we can set up the duplicate, and please never send passwords. We reply with a short design questionnaire, share the first direction and keep you informed until launch.
